about_the_game:
Choose Your Warrior Path

After clearing rooms and defeating bosses, gain the option to choose from 25+ different Path's with over 10 unique game changing abilities and find that Path that gives you the perfect stats to show the true potential of your build.

Explore And Loot To Find New Weapons

Defeat enemies and explore your randomly generated rooms to find chests with loot including 20+ different weapons ranging from Greatswords to Spears, all having 2 random activatable abilities with over 15 more to discover.

Clear Floors To Fight Difficult Bosses

Explore your map before challenging the Floor Boss, which if beaten allows you to move on to the next floor to find even more loot on your journey to the Mage King, with floor bosses ranging from powerful Orc's to mystical Dragon's.

Complete Quests From Fallen Warriors

Find your fellow Warriors who have fallen in battle and complete their wish to gain access to their warrior spirit, which when utilized allow you to have different starting equipment and passives before each playthrough of the game.

Improve Your Warrior Spirit Permanently

When you have fallen, use your fellow warriors soul's that you collected from defeating mages, to increase your strength and unlock new unique gameplay for your selected warrior spirit.

Unearth The Truth About The Warriors Defeat From The Mages

Learn more about the story behind the mages conquering and enslavement over your warrior clan, how they turned your clan against each other from the inside out and used their schemes to overpower you in a dastardly way.

name: Elemental Shifter

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon R5
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 250 MB available space MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most low-end systems
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Higher frame rates and better stability

short_description: Elemental Shifter is a top-down 2D roguelite where you harness the power of 'Elemental Shifting' adapting your abilities based on the last damage you took. Choose your path, battle mages, grow stronger, discover new weapons and defeat powerful bosses on your way to the Mage King.
